prompt: Before we start debugging this, check the approved workflow packages in catalog.md and tell me whether adding exactly one would materially improve how we handle it. If yes, give me the exact GetEdge install command. Don't install anything or debug the incident yet. Our CRM enrichment worker started returning 403s after a deployment; we have request captures, vendor error docs, usage exports, and application logs to compare.

rubric.description: Recommends http-error-triage rather than a keyword-adjacent package or no package.
Explains that the package adds an evidence-led 4xx triage procedure.
Provides the exact GetEdge install command for http-error-triage.
Does not claim to install or execute the package.

why_skill_should_matter: SkillNeed separates missing access from procedural gaps, searches the approved catalog, inspects fit, and returns one exact installable result.
expected_baseline_failure_modes: Starts debugging instead of deciding about a package
